editorial:
Imagine falling for someone who isn't just from a different background, but a completely different world. You get to follow Kass, a smart Cambridge grad from Bradford, who crosses paths with Dorian, a shy guy living in Ilkley. The catch is that Dorian is actually a witch. While their chemistry is instant and sweet, there is a dark cloud hanging over them in the form of Nana Agnes. She is not your typical grandma; she wants Dorian to ignore his feelings and keep a sinister family bloodline going. The whole vibe feels like a cozy romance mixed with a creepy family mystery, making you root for the couple while fearing what the grandmother has up her sleeve.

The acting feels real and honest, especially the tension between the grandkids and the matriarch. You will love how the movie balances the magic elements with the gritty feel of Bradford. While some parts of the middle section drag a bit, the emotional payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy stories about forbidden love and secret powers, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Nana Agnes tries to use a powerful spell to force Dorian into her bloodline, but Kass's unconditional love breaks the magic. Dorian finally stands up to his grandmother and rejects her dark path. It turns out Dorian wasn't manipulating Kass at all; their love was genuine. The movie ends with them choosing each other over family tradition, leaving the sinister bloodline broken and starting a new life together in Bradford.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural romances and family drama.
